SAP LABS Interview Experience
For 2024 Summer Internship (On-campus)
Riya Kasture | B.Tech IT [2021-2025 Batch]
SAP Labs India is SAP's largest Research and Development centre outside its
headquarters in Germany. It has one of the best and most used ERP software
and cloud computing services in the world.
Eligibility criteria: 70 % or 7 CGPA and above in current graduating degree
Job location:
Bangalore/Pune/Mumbai/Hyderabad/Gurgaon
Round 1: Online Coding Round
It was held on 8th November at 6.00 pm and was of 45 min duration. It was
SHL Proctored and had support for all the major languages with IDE. It had 2
easy level coding questions for me, but for some other people it had medium
level questions as well.
Both questions were in a story format with a lot of unnecessary details, so
choosing what is relevant, i.e., input format, required operations on input and
output format is important.
Coding Question 1:
Input: a string
Output: an integer representing the count of characters which are not repeated
in the above input string.If no such character is found or the input string is
empty then print 0.
Sample Test Case:
Input: alphaadida
Output: 4
Explanation: Non repeating characters in the above string are l,p,h,i therefore
the output is 4.

Coding Question 2:
Input: First line consists of an integer representing the size of the list and second
line consists of a list of the above integer size. The list has positive integers.
Output: space separated integers representing distinct elements obtained by
removing the duplicate elements from the given list.
Sample Test Case:
Input:
8
1 1 3 2 1 4 5 4
Output: 1 3 2 4 5
Explanation: after removing all the duplicates (1 and 4) we get the answer as
1 3 2 4 5
Both the questions had 13 test cases.
I passed all the test cases of both the questions and submitted the test within
12 minutes.
Round 2: Technical Interview I (10.00 AM)
20 students were selected for this round. It was conducted on Microsoft Teams
Platform from 9 am onwards on 21st November. It lasted for around 30 mins for
me.
●First the interviewer introduced himself and then asked me to be
comfortable and take this as a friendly conversation. He said he wants to
see the best in me so if the interview goes to a topic I don't know much
about, I'll just tell him that.
●The interview started with a brief introduction of mine. Make sure you
prepare an introduction of yourself before going to any interview.
●Data Structures:
i.What are data structures and their different types and which all data
structures you have used
ii. Difference between arrays and linked lists: I defined both the data
structures and then pointed out their advantages and disadvantages.
iii.Exception handling in cpp.(I already said in my intro that cpp was my
main language). Runtime exceptions and how to overcome them.
iv.BFS vs DFS (what are those,time complexity,space complexity). which is
better when it comes to large amounts of data.

v.typedef(I wasn’t sure about this so I told him this concept is related to
data type but I don’t remember it. He said it was fine and didn’t continue
the topic.)
vi.Stack vs queue and their real life applications.
vii.Priority Queue and Circular Queue
●OOP:
i.4 pillars of OOP
ii.Explain polymorphism and its types
iii.Multiple vs multilevel inheritance
iv.Virtual function
v. He also asked a question about inheritance in java but then I said that
java was not my main language so he said it was okay.
●DBMS:
i.What all databases I have used:- Mongodb and SQL
ii.Advantages and disadvantages of Mongodb
iii. Mongodb vs SQL(I started with the definition but he said he wanted to
know the main difference. I told him that sql follows ACID properties but
Mongodb doesn’t. He was quite satisfied with my answer)
iv.This was a rapid fire kind of question.He said I had to pick Mongodb or
sql based on the keywords he provided
a.Scalability
b.Memory usage
Then he asked the reason for my answers.
●Problem Solving:
This was an easy to medium question. Print a pascal’s triangle with star
pattern.
●
What do you know about the newly emerging technologies like AI/ML.
Give some examples of real world applications which use AI/ML.
In the end, he asked if I had any questions for him. I asked him two questions:
1.What has been your experience in SAP Labs so far?
2.What is SAP's work culture like?
Note: Always ask 1-2 questions at the end of an interview. Prepare 5-6 questions
to ask an interviewer.

Round 3: Technical Interview II (12.00 PM)
17 students were selected for this round. It was conducted on Microsoft
Teams Platform on the same day. It lasted for around 30 min for me.
●I was again asked to introduce myself and describe all my projects.
She did not seem to be happy with my first project because it
wasn’t real time and didn’t have active users.In my second project
our team had used web scraping to complete 60% of the project.I
told her about the difficulties faced and how we overcame them.
She was satisfied with my answer.
●Inheritance. What is an alternative to carry out multiple inheritance in
Java without using classes.
●Java vs cpp
●Error handling in cpp
●What do you know about software management in an organisation(I
pointed out some concepts from the SE subject.)
●Process Synchronisation and Virtual memory (some basic questions under
virtual memory also)
●Write a pseudocode in cpp to add two numbers without using + operator
Approach: int addition(int a ,int b)
{
int sum = a-(-b);
return sum;
}
●What other fields have you explored other than web development ?
●She also asked me a puzzle similar to the water jug problem. You are given
a jug of 4 ltr and a bucket of 9 ltr filled with water. You are given two more
empty buckets and fill them in such a way that water in both the buckets
when measured is 6 ltr. I didn’t get time to solve the entire problem but
she was satisfied with the approach I was using. I was asked to type all my
answers in the chat box.
Note: The interviewers are more interested in your thinking process and the
approach you use to solve a problem. So whatever you think, explain to them
which shows them that you are trying hard to arrive at the solution.

Round 4: HR Interview (4:30 PM)
13 students were selected for this round. It was conducted on Microsoft
Teams Platform again It was about 5-7 min long for me.
It was a very relaxed round; the interviewer was very friendly.He introduced
himself and then asked me to introduce myself.
i.Why do I want to join SAP?
ii.What is your preferred location and will you be able to relocate if asked?
iii.Are you open to new technologies or want to keep using the old ones?
Finally, he asked me if I had any questions for him.I asked him his journey in
SAP and what would be the location for the interns.
After the HR round, 7 students were selected for the internship programme
and I was glad to be one among them.
Resources I used:
●DSA: 450 DSA ,Striver 180,Aditya Verma Playlist (for DP)
●OS: Gate Smashers Playlist, Geek for Geeks,InterviewBit
●OOPS: Love Babbar sheet, InterviewBit, Geek for Geeks
●DBMS: Love Babbar sheet, InterviewBit
●SQL: SQL Queries
●Puzzles: Geek for Geeks
●Aptitude Questions: Indiabix

Tips:
●Be confident
●Stick to one or two resources and go through them thoroughly
●Before going to the interview, research well about the company.Keep
5-6 questions ready for situations when the interviewer asks you if you
have any questions. This will also help in HR questions
●DO NOT LIE ON YOUR RESUME. Always prepare your resume well
before an interview because they do ask many questions on the same.
●If at some point you feel you don’t know a concept ask the interviewer
for a hint. No one expects you to know everything.
●While solving a problem or a puzzle make sure you think out loud. The
interviewer sees your thought process in order to reach the solution.
●Don’t feel low if you get rejected. I also got rejected in the CITI
interview but I didn’t repeat the same mistakes in SAP. Therefore take
it as an interview experience and not rejection.Good things take
time.Have patience :)
●Always go through the previous year experiences of the company
interviews for which you are appearing
●Interview processes are tiring but never lose your hopes.Keep checking
for updates.
ALL THE BEST GUYS!!
YOU’ll SURELY ROCK IT!
